stories.title: Fausses infos sur la présence de drogue dans le sac de Rima Hassan : Laurent Nuñez dément avoir «organisé» les fuites dans la presse

en.title: False information about drugs in Rima Hassan's bag: Laurent Nuñez denies having 'organized' media leaks
en.summary: France's Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez denied orchestrating press leaks regarding false claims about synthetic drugs allegedly found in MEP Rima Hassan's bag. His office stated the minister's remarks were made off-the-record.

stories.title: EN DIRECT - Présidentielle 2027 :«Le PS aurait pu s’épargner cette affaire», lance Olivier Faure sur les accusations visant Philippe Brun

en.title: LIVE - 2027 Presidential election: 'The PS could have spared itself this affair,' Olivier Faure launches on accusations targeting Philippe Brun
en.summary: Socialist Party leader Olivier Faure commented on accusations against Philippe Brun, stating the party could have avoided the situation. He affirmed belief in the accuser's account while noting limited personal involvement in details.

stories.title: Après les menaces de Donald Trump, l’UE assure que son rapprochement avec le Canada n’est «dirigé contre personne»

en.title: After Donald Trump's threats, the EU assures that its rapprochement with Canada is 'directed against no one'
en.summary: The European Union stated that its closer engagement with Canada does not constitute an anti-American alliance, responding to Donald Trump's threats of retaliation.

stories.title: Laurent Nuñez accusé d'avoir participé à la diffusion d'une fausse information visant Rima Hassan

en.title: Laurent Nuñez accused of participating in the dissemination of false information targeting Rima Hassan
en.summary: France's Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez was implicated in spreading false information about synthetic drugs in MEP Rima Hassan's bag during her April detention. The minister denied organizing any leaks.

stories.title: Hausse du prix du carburant : les mobilisations de pêcheurs se poursuivent dans l’Hérault et à Nice

en.title: Rise in fuel prices: fishermen mobilizations continue in Hérault and Nice
en.summary: Fishermen blocked access to oil depots for a second consecutive day on Thursday to protest fuel price increases. The fishing minister was scheduled to meet with them later that morning.

stories.title: Rima Hassan : le ministre Laurent Nuñez accusé d’avoir participé à la diffusion d’une information inexacte sur de la prétendue drogue détenue par l’élue LFI

en.title: Rima Hassan: Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez accused of helping spread inaccurate information about alleged drugs held by the LFI elected official
en.summary: An investigation program reports that the interior minister personally contributed to spreading inaccurate information regarding drugs allegedly held by a left-wing member of parliament in April.

stories.title: Prix des carburants : des pêcheurs bloquent à nouveau un dépôt pétrolier dans l’Hérault

en.title: Fuel prices: fishermen again block an oil depot in Hérault
en.summary: Fishermen blocked an oil depot in Frontignan and the port of Sète starting at 3 a.m. to protest rising fuel prices ahead of their meeting with the sea and fisheries minister.

stories.title: Donald Trump menace d'arrêter les échanges commerciaux avec l'UE si elle maintient son projet d'association avec le Canada

en.title: Donald Trump threatens to halt commercial exchanges with the EU if it maintains its association project with Canada
en.summary: The U.S. president stated he would impose heavy tariffs or cease all trade with Europe if he considers the EU's Canada association plan a hostile act.

stories.title: Donald Trump irrité par le projet d'association de l'UE avec le Canada

en.title: Donald Trump irritated by EU's plan to associate with Canada
en.summary: Donald Trump threatened to halt trade with the European Union if it proceeds with making Canada its first associated member country, calling the initiative ridiculous.

stories.title: Prix des carburants : des pêcheurs bloquent l’accès du port de Nice et d’un dépôt pétrolier dans l’Hérault

en.title: Fuel prices: Fishermen block access to Nice port and oil depot in Hérault
en.summary: Fishermen are blocking access to a major port and petroleum facility in protest over fuel prices, ahead of discussions with the government's delegated minister for fishing and maritime affairs.

stories.title: Projet d’association avec le Canada : Trump menace l’Union européenne de représailles

en.title: EU-Canada association plan: Trump threatens Europe with retaliation
en.summary: The US president views the European proposal for Canada's association status as a hostile act and warns of substantial tariffs or a complete cessation of trade with Europe.

stories.title: Présidentielle 2027 : le PS cherche à éviter que l’affaire Philippe Brun entache la primaire

en.title: 2027 Presidential election: Socialist Party seeks to contain Philippe Brun affair impact on primary
en.summary: A Socialist Party deputy suspended and excluded from the primary over accusations from a former collaborator claims he is being politically targeted through manipulation.

stories.title: GE avance sur le moteur du futur chasseur de l’US Air Force

en.title: GE advances on engine for future US Air Force fighter
en.summary: General Electric is continuing development of its XA102 variable cycle engine for the F-47 fighter jet, building on design methodology and experience gained from the earlier XA100 model.

stories.title: Pour lutter contre les pièces d'avion falsifiées, ARTS veut créer une blockchain souveraine

en.title: To combat counterfeit aircraft parts, ARTS wants to create a sovereign blockchain
en.summary: An aerospace subcontractor near Toulouse airport has established a start-up to launch a blockchain system for aeronautical documentation to help prevent the circulation of counterfeit aircraft components.

stories.title: Batteries sodium-ion : Tiamat « ajourne » son projet d'usine à 200 millions d’euros et 400 emplois près d’Amiens

en.title: Sodium-ion batteries: Tiamat postpones 200 million euro factory project and 400 jobs near Amiens
en.summary: Battery start-up Tiamat has suspended its planned manufacturing facility near Amiens valued at approximately 200 million euros and intended to create 400 jobs due to difficulties securing private financing and will continue production through Asian subcontractors.

stories.title: OPINION. « Faire mieux, plus vite, avec moins : le pari industriel de la construction hors-site »

en.title: OPINION. "Do better, faster, with less: the industrial wager of off-site construction"
en.summary: A network of over 200 construction entities is adopting off-site industrial building methods aimed at improving sector productivity, environmental performance, and attractiveness.

stories.title: OPINION. « Décarbonation : stratégie climatique, levier de croissance et de souveraineté »

en.title: OPINION. "Decarbonization: climate strategy, lever for growth and sovereignty"
en.summary: An opinion piece discusses how decarbonization can serve as both a climate strategy and an economic tool for growth and national sovereignty.
